## Checklist

- [ ] I read the contribution guidelines and followed the target repository's instructions.
- [ ] My change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior, or explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I ran the relevant build, test, formatting, and lint commands.
- [ ] I updated documentation for public APIs, configuration, ports, dependencies, or user-facing behavior.
- [ ] I considered backward compatibility and documented any migration or breaking change.
- [ ] I removed credentials, app secrets, tokens, private message content, and personal data.
